16.t: Working with data: choosing a solar panel
q: Which month gives the most energy?
A family uses 10 kWh a day. Calculate the panel area needed in July.
Suggest why less energy is made in July to September.
The rainy season: more cloud blocks sunlight.
Evaluate solar power for this family, giving one advantage and one problem from the data.
Advantage: no fuel cost, renewable, plenty of sun all year. Problem: output varies by month and is zero at night, so they need the grid or batteries.
